notes.title: New release for adult gamers: Sex Dating Trip!
notes.content:
[b]You want to have sex with every woman you meet? That doesn't have to be a dream![/b]
In this game you go on an [b]sex dating trip[/b]!
In the beginning you meet your girlfriend for a casual date, but it turns into a sex date. 
After that, you can find another girlfriend to sex date right away!

Features:
- Sex Dating in four Level (Normal Date, Private Date, Foreplay Date, Sex Date) and an explosive Happy End Scene when your Errection is 100%
- Multiple Girlfriends
- Cool dating game with skill upgrades and explosive extras!
- Sex and Foreplay with up to 5 sexy babes!
- An interactive Cell Phone with numerous options. For example, you can call a maid!
- Sex Statistics for all Babes
- Full playable Mini-Game "Zombie Shooter" for collecting trophies and money, that you can use in the main game
- Simple Skill System
- Explosive Extras for the dating game (Available at the supermarket in town!)
- Lots of Trophies
- Mobile Phone many functions
